verdict.rationale: Ghostty is a local terminal emulator and embeddable terminal library. It holds no production data and has no service backend, so a sandbox-versus-production test environment does not apply to this kind of product. The systemd cgroup isolation mention is process resource isolation, not a test sandbox, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
